experience.customerProfile: Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited (RFCL) is a fertilizer manufacturing company established to develop a natural-gas-based ammonia and urea complex at Ramagundam, Telangana. The organization operates in the fertilizer manufacturing sector, with its core business focused on the production of ammonia and urea.
experience.techStack: SAP UI5 | SAP Fiori | Fiori Elements | JavaScript | XML | OData | SAP Fiori Launchpad | SAP Backend Integration | JSON | CSS
bullets: Working on SAP UI5 and Fiori application development, enhancement, and support for enterprise business processes.
Developing and maintaining responsive SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5, JavaScript, XML, JSON, and OData.
Working with Fiori Elements and freestyle SAPUI5 applications based on business requirements.
Supporting integration between frontend Fiori applications and SAP backend services using OData.
Analyzing business requirements and translating them into scalable and user-friendly SAP Fiori solutions.
Troubleshooting application issues, debugging UI5 applications, and resolving functional and technical defects.
Working with Fiori Launchpad, including applications, catalogs, tiles, target mappings, and navigation configuration.
Supporting role-based access and application authorization requirements.
Working on UI enhancements, reusable components, responsive layouts, and performance improvements.
Collaborating with functional consultants, backend developers, business users, and customer stakeholders.
Participating in application testing, defect resolution, deployment, and production support activities.
Following SAP development standards and clean-core-oriented practices wherever applicable.
hcmBullets: Developed and enhanced Fiori applications for employee leave management, including leave requests, approvals, leave balances, and employee leave information.
Worked on annual and mid-year appraisal processes, supporting employee performance reviews, manager evaluations, and approval workflows.
Supported employee bonus-related applications and processes, including employee/manager views and workflow-related functionality.
Worked on applications related to employee working hours, attendance, and work-time information.
Developed responsive SAPUI5 interfaces for employee and manager HR processes using SAPUI5, Fiori Elements, JavaScript, XML, and OData.
Integrated frontend applications with SAP backend HCM services through OData APIs.
Implemented role-based functionality for Employees, Managers, and HR users.
Performed application enhancements, debugging, testing, defect resolution, and production support for HCM-related Fiori applications.

bullets: Developed and maintained SAP UI5 custom, standalone and Fiori Elements applications using SAPUI5, OData, and CAPM.
Migrated 30+ applications from SAP Neo to Cloud Foundry.
Deployed applications on SAP BTP, SAP Work Zone, and SAP Build Code.
Integrated secure backend services and implemented role-based authorizations using SAP BTP.
Collaborated on CI/CD pipelines and deployment activities using Git and DevOps practices.
Optimized application performance using efficient data binding and scalable UI architecture.
Developed and enhanced ESS and MSS Fiori applications.
Supported HR processes, approvals, employee management workflows, and role-based authorization.
Integrated frontend applications with backend OData services.
Built SAP Fiori Elements applications including List Report, Object Page, Overview Page and customer dashboards.
Supported Fiori upgrades, regression testing, unit testing and post-upgrade issue resolution.
Developed and extended SAP standard applications using SAPUI5 and OData.
Configured and mapped SAP GUI T-Codes to Fiori Launchpad tiles.
Used semantic objects, target mappings and role-based catalogs/groups.
Managed FLP tile configuration and navigation.
Enabled secure access to backend transactions.
Improved UI responsiveness through performance tuning and model optimization.
Collaborated with senior developers to deliver SAPUI5 applications using agile delivery practices.
Developed custom SAP UI5 applications using XML views and fragments.
Worked with Smart Controls.
Implemented responsive tables, dialogs, filters and charts.
Integrated frontend applications with OData V2 services.
